body:
## Pull request overview

This PR redesigns the spec-layer metadata protocols to support datasource-backed persistence (DB storage) and aligns runtime consumers with a fully-async `IMetadataService` contract, enabling backend swapping via driver plugins.

**Changes:**
- Extend `MetadataRecordSchema` with ADR-0002 fields (tenant/version/checksum/source/tags) and add datasource-oriented manager config + fallback strategy.
- Tighten metadata loader `protocol` to a colon-suffixed enum including `datasource:` across system + kernel layers.
- Make `IMetadataService` fully async with a new `register(type, name, data)` signature and add `exists()` / `listNames()`, updating dev stubs and `MetadataFacade`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/system/metadata-persistence.zod.ts | Adds ADR-0002 fields, loader protocol enum, fallback/source enums, and datasource-backed manager config. |
| packages/spec/src/system/metadata-persistence.test.ts | Updates/extends tests for new record fields, protocol enum, and manager config defaults. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-loader.zod.ts | Aligns kernel-layer loader protocol enum and adds fallback + datasource config fields. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-loader.test.ts | Updates tests for colon-suffixed protocols and new manager config fields. |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts | Makes metadata service contract async; changes `register` signature; adds `exists`/`listNames`. |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.test.ts | Updates contract tests to async interface and new required methods. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin.ts | Updates dev metadata stub to the new async `IMetadataService` shape. |
| packages/objectql/src/metadata-facade.ts | Updates facade to async methods and adds `exists()`/`listNames()`. |
</details>



<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**packages/objectql/src/metadata-facade.ts:27**
* `register(type, name, data)` accepts an explicit `name`, but the implementation chooses the registry key based on whether `definition.id` exists (`id` vs `name`). This can make `register()`/`get()` inconsistent (items stored under `id` won’t be retrievable via `get(type, name)`), and it can also overwrite `definition.name` with the passed `name` even when `name` is actually an id. Consider always keying by the explicit `name` parameter (or clearly renaming the parameter to `key` and setting the matching field) so the facade behaves deterministically.
```
  async register(type: string, name: string, data: any): Promise<void> {
    const definition = typeof data === 'object' && data !== null
      ? { ...data, name: data.name ?? name }
      : data;
    if (type === 'object') {
      SchemaRegistry.registerItem(type, definition, 'name' as any);
    } else {
      SchemaRegistry.registerItem(type, definition, definition.id ? 'id' as any : 'name' as any);
    }
```
</details>

`MetadataLoaderContractSchema.protocol` was tightened to an enum with colon-suffixed values. There are still in-repo `MetadataLoaderContract` implementations using `'file'`/`'http'` (e.g. `packages/metadata/src/loaders/filesystem-loader.ts`, `packages/metadata/src/loaders/remote-loader.ts`), which will no longer type-check against this schema. Either update those contracts to `'file:'`/`'http:'` (and any other call sites) or keep this field as `z.string()` with validation elsewhere to avoid breaking downstream packages.
```suggestion
  protocol: z.string().describe('Loader protocol identifier'),
```

`MetadataRecordSchema.version` is currently `z.number().default(1)`, which allows non-integers and negative values. For optimistic concurrency/versioning, this should be constrained to an integer and typically `>= 1` (e.g. `.int().min(1)`) to prevent invalid versions entering persisted metadata.
```suggestion
  version: z.number().int().min(1).default(1).describe('Record version for optimistic concurrency control'),
```

`MetadataRecordSchema.source` duplicates the same enum values as the newly introduced `MetadataSourceSchema` below, which risks drift if one is updated without the other. Consider reusing `MetadataSourceSchema` here (e.g. `source: MetadataSourceSchema.optional()`) so there is a single source of truth for allowed origins.

`MetadataLoaderContractSchema.protocol` is now an enum with colon-suffixed values, but there are existing loader contracts in the repo still using `'file'`/`'http'` (without `:`). If kernel-layer loader contracts are consumed outside spec, those implementations will break at compile time unless updated to the new values (or this schema remains a string).

`MetadataFacade.register` falls back to passing non-object `data` straight into `SchemaRegistry.registerItem`, but `registerItem` expects an object with a key field (it reads `item[keyField]`). If a caller passes a primitive/invalid value, this will throw at runtime. Consider validating that `data` is a non-null object (and throwing a clear error) before delegating to `SchemaRegistry`.

The dev metadata stub switched to the new async `register(type, name, data)` signature, but this is a breaking change for existing stub consumers that still call `register(type, definition)` and treat `get/list` as sync (e.g. `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin.test.ts`). Update those call sites to pass `name` explicitly and `await` the async methods to keep the dev-plugin contract tests compiling.
